**Package:** eBMR / eDHR Claude Code Construction Package
**Status:** Populated 2026-09-09 (WP-00 Phase 2) from the built stack; regenerated by CI on every build.
**Specification baseline:** Documents 01–105 + Document 104 (SPEC-ENG-008), 68 (SPEC-SEC-008).
**Purpose:** Approved technology baseline + the concrete dependency register for the built artefacts.

## Approved technology baseline

The frozen Document 02 §6.1 ADRs, with the supersessions recorded in `docs/adr/`:

| Component | Frozen decision | Current decision | ADR |
|---|---|---|---|
| Application / operator UI | Frappe | **Next.js SPA (`frontend/`) reading the GxP API directly** | ADR-0008 → **ADR-0010** |
| Frappe operational DB | MariaDB | not deployed (no projection tier — SG-182) | ADR-0002 → ADR-0010 |
| GxP authoritative DB | PostgreSQL 14 | unchanged | ADR-0003 |
| Identity | Keycloak-compatible / customer SSO | unchanged (local password fallback in dev) | ADR-0004 |
| Durable workflow | Temporal | **real Temporal dev-server, `app/modules/workflowops/*` (WP-11 Stage 2) — one real workflow (StepStuckDetectionWorkflow) built; the rest of Document 11's Temporal-dependent scope remains on the stand-in** | ADR-0006 → **ADR-0011** |
| Event bus | NATS-compatible | **real NATS JetStream, single-node, `app/modules/eventbus/jetstream.py` (WP-11 Stage 1)** | ADR-0008 → **ADR-0011** |
| Object storage | S3-compatible | `LocalEvidenceStore` in dev; S3 adapter is the target | ADR-0009 |
| GxP service language | TypeScript/Node.js LTS | **Python 3.12 + FastAPI + async SQLAlchemy 2.0 + Alembic** | ADR-010 → **ADR-0007** |
| Contracts | OpenAPI 3.1 + JSON Schema + AsyncAPI | unchanged (`contracts/openapi/`, `contracts/events/`) | ADR-0003 |
| Deployment | containers / Kubernetes-compatible | target; `app/modules/deployment` scaffolds the checks | ADR-0012 (roadmap) |

## Register schema

```csv
ecosystem,name,version,source,purpose,direct_or_transitive,scope,license,license_status,security_status,owner,approval_reference,sbom_document
```

## Rules (Document 104)

- No package with **UNKNOWN** or **PROHIBITED** licence enters a released build (enforced: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` → `supply-chain` → *Licence gate*).
- Every direct dependency has a named owner and an approval reference.
- Production dependencies are pinned via lockfile (`services/gxp-api/uv.lock`, `frontend/package-lock.json`); floating ranges are prohibited in release builds (DEP-FR-005).
- Adding a dependency requires the Document 104 justification recorded in `pyproject.toml` / this file: why needed, whether an approved dependency already solves it, licence, security/EOL, SBOM effect, alternatives, approval (DEP-FR-017).
- Crypto / auth / parser / native / runtime-critical libraries need Security + Architecture approval (DEP-FR-018).

## Operator UI (`frontend`) — dependency register

Minimal footprint: **3 direct production dependencies**, **29 resolved production components**
(`--omit dev`, matches `frontend/package-lock.json` after `npm ci`). React / Next.js ecosystem, all MIT
except one MPL-2.0/BSD entry noted below.

| name | version | license | status | purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| next | 16.3.2 | MIT | APPROVED | React framework / App Router (ADR-0010) |
| react | 19.2.8 | MIT | APPROVED | UI runtime |
| react-dom | 19.2.8 | MIT | APPROVED | DOM renderer |
| _dev:_ typescript, eslint, eslint-config-next, tailwindcss, @tailwindcss/postcss, @types/* | ^5 / ^9 / 16.3.2 / ^4 | MIT / MIT | dev-only | build + lint |

Notable transitive components (from `sbom/sbom-frontend.cdx.json`, scan 2026-09-10): `@next/swc-linux-x64-gnu`
/ `-musl` (native, MIT, Next's Rust compiler), `sharp` + `@img/sharp-*` (native, image optimization, Apache-2.0/MIT),
`styled-jsx`, `scheduler`, `caniuse-lite` (CC-BY-4.0-style data, non-code), `nanoid`, `picocolors`,
`source-map-js`. No UNKNOWN or PROHIBITED licences found — **licence posture: clean.**

Full component list with versions and PURLs: `sbom/sbom-frontend.cdx.json`.

## Open items

- Security + Architecture sign-off recorded for the SECURITY-CRITICAL rows (jose/cryptography/bcrypt/ecdsa/rsa) — DEP-FR-018.
- NATS + Temporal client dependencies (ADR-0011) get Document 104 justification entries here **before** they are added.
- Container base image + OS packages appear in the SBOM once a Dockerfile exists (DEP-FR-020) — none yet.
- SBOM retention per released version (DEP-FR-034) — starts at the first tagged release.
- **`npm audit` finding (2026-09-10, DEP-FR-012/013 — not yet actioned):** `npm audit --omit dev` against
  the committed lockfile reports 2 advisories in direct/near-direct production dependencies —
  `next@16.3.2` (in range 16.0.0–16.3.2): **critical**, unauthenticated RCE on Windows-hosted servers
  (GHSA-p293-qw3h-jr36) and RCE in the Image Optimization API via AVIF (GHSA-2xp9-vwfh-vxw4); `sharp<0.35.4`
  (transitive, via `next`'s image optimizer): **high**, libheif CVEs (GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c). A compatible
  fix exists (`next@16.3.4`, `sharp` non-major bump via `npm audit fix`) but was **not applied** in this
  ratchet pass — it is a dependency-version change outside this task's declared scope (Phase 2 backbone
  item 2 = commit the SBOM, not patch dependencies) and needs the Document 104 update-review path
  (DEP-FR-025) plus a DEP-FR-018 note since it touches the app's image-handling surface. Flagged for the
  next dependency-update PR; not blocking today's build (this deployment does not run on Windows and the
  AVIF/image-optimization endpoint is not yet exposed), but should not sit long given the "critical" rating.
